payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the proposed similarity measure over BM25, quantifying the gains in average precision and NDCG scores.

claims.text: The embedding approach boosts the average precision of BM25 by 19% and 6% on TREC 2006 and 2007, respectively.
Using titles (BM25 + SEMTitle) increases NDCG@20 by 23%, NDCG@10 by 25%, and NDCG@5 by 23% compared to BM25.
The proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 on TREC and PubMed datasets.
The experimental results showed that the new approach was better than BM25 ranking based solely on semantic measures.
